command:
sha=$(gh pr view --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) || exit 1
# GitHub starts no CI run on a PR that conflicts with its base: exit 3 is stale, the story
# updates its branch instead of waiting. UNKNOWN is GitHub still computing: asked again briefly.
mergeable() {
  m=UNKNOWN
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    m=$(gh pr view --json mergeable -q .mergeable) || return 1
    [ "$m" != UNKNOWN ] && return 0
    sleep 5
  done
}
conflicting() { [ "$m" = CONFLICTING ] && echo "PR conflicts with its base: no CI runs on it until the branch takes the base"; }
mergeable || exit 1
conflicting && exit 3
run=
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  run=$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --commit "$sha" --event pull_request --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId')
  [ -n "$run" ] && break
  sleep 10
done
if [ -z "$run" ]; then
  mergeable || exit 1
  conflicting && exit 3
  echo "no ci.yml run for $sha after 5m (PR mergeable: $m)"
  exit 1
fi
gh run watch "$run" --exit-status --interval 30 >/dev/null && exit 0
sh .agents/scripts/ci-failures.sh "$run"
exit 1
